audit.why: Mirror (galio__poppy) already established: early belongs to Poppy on stats, Galio's window opens at 3+ around the Steadfast Presence cooldown, and from 6 it becomes a roam lane. Current text matches that shape.
audit.corrected: Kept: even lane, 6/10, decided by whether you track Justice Punch and hold W for it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written generically — 'Galio's ultimate changes the math too' — without naming Hero's Entrance, its 180/160/140s cooldown, or the fact that it cancels your Keeper's Verdict channel.
audit.why: Poppy R is flagged channel (interruptible — any CC cancels it). Galio's R lands a knockup and his W is a taunt; both cancel it.
audit.corrected: Named Hero's Entrance with its cooldown at phases[4].why, whys[4] and spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: Page never stated the two decisive interactions: Steadfast Presence (W, 20/18/16/14/12s) stopping Justice Punch (E, 11/10/9/8/7s) mid-dash and leaving him slowed and grounded; and Shield of Durand / Hero's Entrance cancelling your Keeper's Verdict channel.
audit.why: Poppy W explicitly stops dashes and grounds the dasher on a stop; Galio's only gap-close is Justice Punch. Poppy R is a channel and Galio carries two CC tools.
audit.corrected: Stated in tldr, dosFull[2].d, breakdown.cooldowns, mid, whys[4], spikes[1].text.

audit.why: Real cooldowns make the advice actionable — W at 20s rank 1 versus his E at 11s means you cannot parry every dash.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d now carry the numbers.

edits.before: Bait his key tool — wall-stun him on the Justice Punch cooldown — your W deletes dashes. Poppy wins the Justice Punch cooldown windows.
edits.after: Steadfast Presence eats Justice Punch mid-flight (his 11s against your 20s) — bait it, then Heroic Charge him into a wall. That window is the lane.

edits.before: Keeper’s Verdict punts the fight’s biggest threat across the map. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Galio's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance (140s) shields him and knocks you up, and it cancels your Keeper's Verdict channel — never start R while his ultimate is up.

edits.before: Galio wastes Justice Punch — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: W as Justice Punch fires — his dash dies, he is slowed and grounded.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: W is 20s at rank 1; spend it early and his Justice Punch is free.

edits.before: E-ing with no wall behind him — the wall-stun is the whole trade; the dash alone is a tickle.
edits.after: Winds of War reaches 825 and ticks over time — sidestep the tornado, don't stand in it farming.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash + knockup engage. Punish him when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch (11/10/9/8/7s): his dash-knockup engage — W stops it mid-dash and leaves him grounded. - Shield of Durand (18s): a taunt that cancels your R channel. - Keeper's Verdict: only once that taunt is spent.

edits.before: His R is his one power swing — he can Flash-R engage or ult a roam, so this window belongs to him; play around his ult timer.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance is his one swing — 140s at rank 3, it knocks you up, shields him, and cancels your Keeper's Verdict; track that timer.

edits.before: Galio's R is his only real swing window — he can flash-R or ult a roaming ally to gank, so respect the global the moment it comes up.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance (180s at rank 1) is his one swing — Flash-R or a roam gank, and its landing knockup cancels your Keeper's Verdict channel.

edits.before: Hold W damage-reduction taunt for your E-Q all-in and turn the trade
edits.after: Hold Shield of Durand's taunt (18s) for your all-in and turn the trade

edits.before: His MR stacking is wasted on you — your Q is physical and percent-HP, so he can't itemize you out of the lane. Keep forcing short trades: bait his W taunt, then E-wall-stun and Q once it's burned. At 6 his R is the only thing that swings the lane, so the moment it's up respect a Flash-R engage or a roam onto your jungler, and ping it the second it goes onto an ally.
edits.after: His MR stacking is wasted on you — your Q is physical and percent-HP, so he can't itemize you out of the lane. Keep forcing short trades: bait Shield of Durand (18s), then Heroic Charge him into a wall and Q once the taunt is burned. From 6, Hero's Entrance is the swing — respect Flash-R and roams, and never channel Keeper's Verdict while his taunt or ult is up.
